borebi.title: Full Stack Development Intern
borebi.description:
- Built 4 internal web systems in **Laravel** and unified 3 into one app, cutting duplication and maintenance.
- Frontend in **React + TypeScript via Inertia.js**, over a **13-entity** model with **50+ routes** (auth, RBAC, validation).
- Digitalized paper-based public workflows and run deployment and evolutionary maintenance in production.

solidTech.description:

- Gamification (haptics, feeds, rankings), B2B dashboards with **Pix** checkout, and full logistics apps.
